SELECT BU, 
(SUM(attainment_flag)/SUM(recom_flag))*100 AS Attainment_Percentage,
(SUM(reached_flag)/SUM(recom_flag))*100 AS Reach_Percentage,
((SUM(CASE WHEN ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal') THEN Total_act_calls ELSE 0 END) + 
SUM(CASE WHEN ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal' THEN Total_calls ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(Total_calls)) * 100 AS Execution_Percentage,
  ((SUM(CASE WHEN ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal') THEN Act_calls_rev ELSE 0 END) +
  SUM(CASE WHEN ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal' THEN calls_rev ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(calls_rev)) * 100 AS Percentage_to_Plan
FROM p2p_dd
WHERE BU IN ("CMH", "NBU", "OBU", "IMM")
GROUP BY BU;

SELECT 'Total_Opportunity_Suggested_in_thousands' AS Metric,
  SUM(IF(BU='CMH' AND recom_flag='1', calls_p1, 0))/1000 AS CMH,
  SUM(IF(BU='NBU' AND recom_flag='1', calls_p1, 0))/1000 AS NBU,
  SUM(IF(BU='OBU' AND recom_flag='1', calls_p1, 0))/1000 AS OBU,
  SUM(IF(BU='IMM' AND recom_flag='1', calls_p1, 0))/1000 AS IMM
FROM p2p_dd

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Revenue_in_Millions_From_Total_Opportunity_Suggested',
  SUM(IF(BU='CMH', calls_p1_rev, 0))/1e6,
  SUM(IF(BU='NBU', calls_p1_rev, 0))/1e6,
  SUM(IF(BU='OBU', calls_p1_rev, 0))/1e6,
  SUM(IF(BU='IMM', calls_p1_rev, 0))/1e6
FROM p2p_dd

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Suggested_Opportunity_Executed_in_thousands',
  (SUM(IF(BU='CMH' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='CMH' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1, 0)))/1000,
  (SUM(IF(BU='NBU' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='NBU' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1, 0)))/1000,
  (SUM(IF(BU='OBU' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='OBU' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1, 0)))/1000,
  (SUM(IF(BU='IMM' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='IMM' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1, 0)))/1000
FROM p2p_dd

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Revenue_in_Millions_From_Suggested_Opportunity_Executed',
  (SUM(IF(BU='CMH' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1_rev, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='CMH' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1_rev, 0)))/1e6,
  (SUM(IF(BU='NBU' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1_rev, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='NBU' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1_rev, 0)))/1e6,
  (SUM(IF(BU='OBU' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1_rev, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='OBU' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1_rev, 0)))/1e6,
  (SUM(IF(BU='IMM' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1_rev, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='IMM' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1_rev, 0)))/1e6
FROM p2p_dd

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Total_Opportunity_Executed_in_thousands',
  SUM(IF(BU='CMH' AND execution_flag='1', act_calls_p1, 0))/1000,
  SUM(IF(BU='NBU' AND execution_flag='1', act_calls_p1, 0))/1000,
  SUM(IF(BU='OBU' AND execution_flag='1', act_calls_p1, 0))/1000,
  SUM(IF(BU='IMM' AND execution_flag='1', act_calls_p1, 0))/1000
FROM p2p_dd

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Revenue_in_Millions_From_Total_Opportunity_Executed',
  SUM(IF(BU='CMH' AND execution_flag='1', act_calls_p1_rev, 0))/1e6,
  SUM(IF(BU='NBU' AND execution_flag='1', act_calls_p1_rev, 0))/1e6,
  SUM(IF(BU='OBU' AND execution_flag='1', act_calls_p1_rev, 0))/1e6,
  SUM(IF(BU='IMM' AND execution_flag='1', act_calls_p1_rev, 0))/1e6
FROM p2p_dd

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Suggested_Opportunity_Not_Executed_in_thousands',
  (SUM(IF(BU='CMH' AND recom_flag='1', calls_p1, 0)) - 
   (SUM(IF(BU='CMH' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='CMH' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1, 0))))/1000,
  (SUM(IF(BU='NBU' AND recom_flag='1', calls_p1, 0)) - 
   (SUM(IF(BU='NBU' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='NBU' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1, 0))))/1000,
  (SUM(IF(BU='OBU' AND recom_flag='1', calls_p1, 0)) - 
   (SUM(IF(BU='OBU' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='OBU' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1, 0))))/1000,
  (SUM(IF(BU='IMM' AND recom_flag='1', calls_p1, 0)) - 
   (SUM(IF(BU='IMM' AND ptp_lov IN ('Missed','Optimal'), act_calls_p1, 0)) + SUM(IF(BU='IMM' AND ptp_lov='Sub-Optimal', calls_p1, 0))))/1000
FROM p2p_dd
